profile.headline: Software Developer Lead at InnovaSystems International LLC
profile.summary: Young, eager professional with a passion for developing quality, user-friendly software.  I am a person who strives for self-growth, and I work continually to expand my own skill set and knowledge in order to advance my career.  I am a strong believer in creating thoroughly-engineered products which work as expected, are efficiently designed and are easy to use by the consumer.

positions.title: Software Developer Lead
positions.description: Supervised junior developers in creating a personnel training management web application for the US Navy.  Reviewed application code and practices to verify STIG compliance.   Worked with business analysts to create and track User Stories and PBIs in Team Foundation Server.  Wrote test cases for applications to ensure quality and correct implementation of requirements.  Implemented Kanban board and facilitated daily meetings to track team progress.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed ASP.NET web forms applications to fulfill the internal business needs of Community Health Group.  Created T-SQL stored procedures to calculate members’ health benefits and eligibility.  Wrote software to generate EDI member eligibility files for use by external vendors.  Created software to generate excel spreadsheets containing claims payment data.  Tasked with creating a database and stored procedures to track provider payments and calculate reimbursement amounts.  Designed and published SQL reports to SSRS.

positions.title: Systems Integrator
positions.description: Wrote software to facilitate data migrations from third party ECM systems into Bluepoint's proprietary system, FastDocs.  This included both the transfer of files and database indices, as well as file reformatting to be compatible with Bluepoint's system.

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description: Wrote scripts to perform quality tests on new releases of software.
